Interesting idea here:

Voat can't handle the massive traffic surge, but Cloudflare DDOS protection is run on their Saas side of things.

The DDOS protection throttles back the number of users who access the servers at once, thus dropping the amount of active connections at any given time. This prevents bots (which is nice) and also gives the servers some breathing space between new logins when all the objects have to be loaded in.

After the initial waiting period and subsequent loadup of the home page, most people now have the icon set and most of the CSS cached. This means less load on the server, and more active uptime ^.^

As far as I know CloudFlare already has some very agressive caching settings to pass all static content through their Content Delivery Network.

CloudFlare is definitely their best option during this time where Voat is down every few hours.

Dollface paces back and forth, an unsettling feeling forces her to keep moving, unable to stop thinking. "Something is wrong, what is it?" She wondered. The ship exits hyperspace, "A little early to be at Voss." She thought.

 

She walks out of the Conference Room and heads to the bridge, "Boris, why have we stopped?". Boris stands facing the exterior windows on the bridge "We are waiting here for June. We are going to escort him into the Temple of healing so he can complete his mission." Boris replies with a tinge of resentment, looking slightly perturbed.

 

*"What is his mission? Is there something we should know?"8 Dollface inquires. Boris turns around, his tone and demeanour changing "Hmm? Oh, no do not worry. June will not interfere with our mission, as he will be busy by himself after we enter the temple." Boris replies.

 

Ding. Boris walks over to the ships holocomm and activates it, June appears. "Hello June, if you would please board my ship as we already have our equipment and people on board here." Boris says in a tranquil tone. "As you wish, I will do so." June replies, disconnecting the holocomm.

 

June turns around and looks at his squad, "Keedenbain and Lingwad, I need you to help Grand Master Satele Shaun in the battle over Voss." he says to his squad. "Aye sir, Aye." Responds Lingwad.

 

 

Dollface, June, Boris, and Boris' squad assemble outside the temple of healing. Boris turns and addresses everyone "Alright everyone, we will be entering and eliminating any empire resistance. Once inside we will split up and continue on with our various missions at the designated meeting area. Everyone understand?"

 

Everyone nods and begins to enter the temple in a diamond formation. They see two droids guarding the first hallway, June throws his lightsabre and decapitates the one on the left. Dollface uses the force to rip a statue off the wall and into the droid on the right, incapacitating it. They proceed throughout the temple meeting little resistance; June turns to Boris and inquires "Have you noticed any imperial forces at all? They seem to be all droids."

 

"Yes, it does seem a bit off doesn't it June." Boris replies while eye-balling June with a look of suspicion. They stop at the end of the hallway, there is a turn to the left, and turn to the right and a large door straight ahead.

 

June turns to Boris "This is where we split. It shouldn't take you too long to clear this place out at this rate, so shall we meet back here in a half-hour?" June asks. "Yes that does sound like a good idea, Dollface, you take Jothan and CondemnedQueen and go right, I will take Andolya and Lightyear and go left, June, I believe this door is yours." Boris replies while pointing towards the door. They agree and go their separate ways.

 

 

June proceeds through the door, down the stairs and throughout the labyrinth of tunnels, guided by the force he finds the main command room for the imperials. June proceeds to the unguided entrance and peeks underneath the door,

"Two sith, finally something with a bit of bite behind them." He says to himself. June opens the door slowly, as not to alert the sith of his presence. He walks in calmly and quietly tip-toeing across the room towards the data core.

 

One of the sith activates his holocomm. Grand Moff Killron appears in shimmering blue light, "Yes, what do you two want?" he asks. "The trap is set, we only have to wait for the Jedi to spring it." the sith pure-blood replies. "Very good, call me after you deal with your unwelcome guest." Killron states while pointing to June. The holocomm deactivates and the two sith turn around.

 

“Who the? How did you? What?! You aren't supposed to be here, we killed you on Hoth!" They express with a start. June, thinking quickly, force pulls the Chiss Sith across the room and into his lightsabre. The pure-blood sith, stands gawking at the scene unfolding in front of him snaps out of his trance, and traps June in a storm of force lightning. "Now how did you get in here? The Jedi said he was coming with five others, not six. Is there anyone else here besides you?" the sith demanded. June, concentrating, forces himself out and strikes the sith, knocking him out.

 

June, gets up wipes himself off, and proceeds to the data core. He looks at the system and realizes the quantity of data. He pulls out a storage crystal, and proceeds to download the data core "This is a lot more then I was expecting for a short assault on Voss, they have been here awhile." June thinks to himself.

 

 

Dollface, after clearing out her side of the temple from imperial droids, heads back to the meeting area. "Good, we are going to be early, we can make sure that the area is clear for everyone else." Dollface says to the others.

 

CondemnedQueen pipes up, "I just have to check on the Voss mystics, I will only be a couple minutes, so you guys go on ahead." His voice cracking at the end. Dollface looks at CondemnedQueen with a look of confusion "That may not be our mission, it is a good idea, however why did you lie just now?" she asks.

 

"Well, I...uh, need to use the restroom. But I will check on the Voss after, and I will be right there!" Dollface examining CondemnedQueen's face turns to him and says "Ok, I believe you; off you go, but be quick! We are out of here in 10 minutes!" CondemnedQueen runs back towards the rear of the temple.

 

Dollface and Jothan return to the meeting spot to see Boris, by himself. "Where is your team Boris?" Dollface inquires. "Trapped, and being shipped off to Dromund Kaas." Boris replied flatly. "Why did you not help them?" Dollface yells.

 

"Quick Jothan, let’s go save the others!". Dollface and Jothan start running towards Boris' hallway, Boris stuns Dollface and Jothan. "You are not going anywhere except to Dromund Kaas with the others." Boris, moving faster than Jothan could see, strikes him down, rendering him unconscious.

 

Dollface starts backing up towards the entrance to the temple when she sees June running flat out towards Boris from down the hallway. Boris notices Dollfaces staring behind him, yells out "You are too late; you will be joining them shortly June.". Boris raises his lightsabre with his left hand, striking it downward towards Dollface, and force pushes the door closed with his right.

 

June slams into the door, "NO!" He yells, banging on the door with his fists. June pulls out his lightsabre and attempts to cut the door down, when he feels a sharp pain the back of his head. June falls to the ground and sees the sith Pure-blood standing over him, kneels down and whispers "So we meet again Gay Dragon, the emperor will be pleased with your capture." The sith pure-blood stands up and raps on the door three times, and booms "For the Empire!" The door swings open revealing Boris standing upright with imperial troopers around working furiously cleaning up the bodies, dragging them out the entrance to the temple. "Stay there June, we will be right back for you." Boris utters, turning around walking towards the entrance.

 

After Boris and the sith walk away, CondemnedQueen runs around the corner "I'm late, I'm late, I'm late!" he says in a rushed tone, he turns his head and sees June lying on the floor. "June what happened!?" He asks, June turns to
